programme.title: plan b / plan b
programme.sub-title: Wut - ihre Macht, ihre Kraft - Und wie wir damit umgehen
programme.desc: Anger is everywhere. It can escalate and destroy. But our anger can be influenced. The psychologist Lukas Klaschinski hits people who move a little positively with their anger. But anger can also become a danger. The good thing: we don't have to be determined by her. A visit to Charite Berlin shows that we can train our brain like a muscle and thus our anger. Now he is on trial because of two, maybe for several years. But the young man wants to others. From the ultra scene, he has long for himself and is now looking for help from an association that helps men like him: Alex learns to find a healthy deal with his anger in the social counseling Stuttgart. For over 15 years, the association has only offered an anti -aggressive training training for men, 200 participants have already successfully completed it. Will Alex get the way out of violence? There are also people who cannot express their anger enough. This can also become a problem and even make it sick. Women in particular are often trained, nice and calm socially instead of startling and anger. Katrin is a mother of four and often doesn't know where to go with her anger in everyday life. She suppresses her feelings for too long to work as a mother - and finally the anger bursts out too much. Her wish is to find a way, to allow her anger to allow her to be a place in everyday life. To learn this, there are so -called industrious seminars, especially for women. Here Katrin learns new ways of anger. In the worst case in the form of real shitstorms, mass insults. The victims are particularly often women. Just like the swimming world champion Angelina Kohler (24). At the Olympic Games in Paris 2024, contrary to all expectations, she only took fourth place, indirectly accuses the third -placed doping in an interview and is then flooded with anger and hate comments. You still follow this traumatic experience. Angelina Kohler was exposed to anger alone, there are organizations that help people like her. Hateaid in Berlin represents victims of digital violence in advice and in court. Inwut is not a pure private matter. Also the anger at politics, awakening to social misery. This can be dangerous: the number of politically motivated crimes has rapidly increased in recent years. Political anger can also help to do things for the better. There is a ship in Spain, the crew of which does exactly that. The aid organization Sea-Watch has saved people in the Mediterranean since 2015 on the run. The German-Moroccan Eliora has been with the aid organization for a year and a half. Your reason: anger on social misstance. On politics. She has learned to convert her anger into something positive: she saves life. The documentation series "Plan B" shows what incredible strength is anger to harm us and what potential to help us and others. / Wut ist uberall. Sie kann eskalieren und zerstoren. Doch unsere Wut lasst sich beeinflussen. Der Psychologe Lukas Klaschinski trifft Menschen, die mit ihrer Wut etwas Positiv bewegen.Jeder von uns wird mal wutend, das ist ganz naturlich. Aber Wut kann auch zur Gefahr werden. Das Gute: Wir mussen uns von ihr nicht bestimmen lassen. Ein Besuch in der Charite Berlin zeigt: Wir konnen unser Gehirn trainieren wie einen Muskel und damit auch unsere Wut.Alex (Name geandert) war jahrelang in der FuSSball-Ultraszene aktiv, ist dort immer wieder gewalttatig geworden. Jetzt steht er wegen zwei Vorfallen vor Gericht, muss vielleicht fur mehrere Jahre ins Gefangnis. Doch der junge Mann will sich andern. Aus der Ultraszene hat er sich losgesagt und sucht nun Hilfe bei einem Verein, der Mannern wie ihm hilft: In der Sozialberatung Stuttgart lernt Alex, einen gesunden Umgang mit seiner Wut zu finden. Seit uber 15 Jahren bietet der Verein ein Antiaggressivitatstraining nur fur Manner an, 200 Teilnehmer haben es schon erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Wird Alex den Weg aus der Gewalt schaffen?Es gibt auch Menschen, die ihre Wut nicht genug zum Ausdruck bringen konnen. Das kann ebenfalls zum Problem werden und sogar krank machen. Gerade Frauen wird gesellschaftlich oft antrainiert, nett und ruhig zu sein, statt aufbrausend und wutend. Katrin ist vierfache Mutter und weiSS im Alltag oft nicht, wohin mit ihrer Wut. Zu lange unterdruckt sie ihre Gefuhle, um als Mutter zu funktionieren - und schlieSSlich platzt die Wut zu stark aus ihr heraus. Ihr Wunsch ist es, einen Weg zu finden, ihre Wut fruher zuzulassen und ihr einen Platz im Alltag einzuraumen. Um das zu lernen, gibt es sogenannte Wutseminare, speziell fur Frauen. Hier lernt Katrin neue Wege der Wutbewaltigung.Besonders ungehemmt begegnet uns Wut dort, wo viele von uns taglich unterwegs sind: im Internet. Im schlimmsten Fall in Form von regelrechten Shitstorms, massenhaften Beleidigungen. Besonders oft sind die Opfer Frauen. So wie die Schwimmweltmeisterin Angelina Kohler (24). Bei den Olympischen Spielen in Paris 2024 belegt sie - entgegen allen Erwartungen - nur den vierten Platz, wirft der Drittplatzierten in einem Interview indirekt Doping vor und wird daraufhin mit Wut und Hasskommentaren regelrecht uberschwemmt. Diese traumatische Erfahrung hangt ihr bis heute nach. Angelina Kohler war der Wut allein ausgesetzt, dabei gibt es Organisationen, die Menschen wie ihr helfen. HateAid in Berlin vertritt Opfer digitaler Gewalt in Beratungen und vor Gericht.Wut ist keine reine Privatangelegenheit. Auch die Wut auf die Politik, auf gesellschaftliche Missstande wachst. Das kann gefahrlich werden: Die Zahl der politisch motivierten Straftaten ist in den letzten Jahren rapide angestiegen. Politische Wut kann aber auch dazu beitragen, Dinge zum Guten zu verandern. In Spanien liegt ein Schiff, dessen Besatzung genau das tut. Die Hilfsorganisation Sea-Watch rettet seit 2015 im Mittelmeer Menschen auf der Flucht, die in Seenot geraten. Die Deutsch-Marokkanerin Eliora ist seit anderthalb Jahren bei der Hilfsorganisation. Ihr Grund: Wut auf gesellschaftliche Missstande. Auf die Politik. Sie hat gelernt, ihre Wut in etwas Positives umzuwandeln: Sie rettet Leben.Die Dokumentationsreihe "plan b" zeigt, welch unglaubliche Kraft Wut besitzt, uns zu schaden und welches Potenzial, uns und anderen zu helfen.

Angereist sind sie stilecht mit Traktoren, Feuerwehrautos, Pool, Kuhlschranken und 700 Litern Bier. Fur sie ist die Party die beste Zeit des Jahres. Das Rennen verspricht Festivalatmosphare mitten in der Eifel.Oliver Roder ist Sternekoch im Restaurant "Eifelers Zeiten" auf Burg Flamersheim, ein historisches Anwesen aus dem 18. Jahrhundert in Euskirchen. Roder hatte viele Jahre lang einen Michelin-Stern im Restaurant Bemberger Hauschen. Zu viel Stress, zu wenig Kunden: Deswegen haben er und sein Team beschlossen, mit einem neuen Konzept ins Jahr 2025 zu starten. Weniger Haute Cuisine, mehr Bodenstandiges aus der Region. Der 42-Jahrige kocht regionale, bodenstandige Kuche der Eifel und interpretiert sie neu und modern. Ochsenbrust, Eifeler Schweinerucken und rote Beete. Die neu interpretierte Eifelkuche kommt bei den Gasten gut an.Die "ZDF.reportage" uber den Sehnsuchtsort Eifel. Zwischen Natur, Freizeit und Fachkraftemangel.

programme.title: Update Uberfallig. How digital is the economy? / Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?
programme.desc: Cover economy, radiohole, outdated software - many medium -sized companies still get problems in digitization in Germany. What is it? But many companies suffer from slow internet, employees have to convey digital know -how - and at the same time face expensive investments. Who prevents progress - and what had to be done for a long time so that Germany's economic engine does not stutter? In the "WISO" documentary "update. ZDF economic expert Florian Neuhann goes to the causes of digital standstill on the basis. Is the main problem in politics? A clear digital strategy was missing for many years. It was only in May this year that the Federal Ministry for Digital was created under the new government - with Karsten Wildberger (CDU) as the first digital minister. A step with symbolic power, but are new tarpaulin and promise? Florian Neuhann meets the minister and investigates whether the digital departure really succeeds - or threatens to fail again on old structures. Too often it said in the past: "We have always done it that way." But rethinking is increasingly taking place - at least since Corona pandemic, medium -sized companies are increasingly investing in digital projects. In 2024 it was almost 32 billion euros. However, large companies in particular benefit. Smaller companies often remain back - they lack resources, personnel and financial planning security to really implement digital projects. The film by Anja Kollruss and Kim Uhlich shows how medium -sized companies are between departure and wait. They accompany companies that feel step forward - and those that are already in the middle of change. The same question arises between technical hurrets, legal uncertainties and limited resources: What does it take so that digitization does not stay a project for a long time - but really arrives in everyday life? In addition to a conversation with Federal Digital Minister Karsten Wildberger, ZDF journalist Florian Neuhann meets this film by manager Julia Jakel, digital expert Aya Jaff and Andrea Thoma-Bock from the "Initiative Zukunftwirtschaft Germany". / Zettelwirtschaft, Funklocher, veraltete Software - viele mittelstandische Unternehmen kampfen in Deutschland noch immer mit Problemen bei der Digitalisierung. Woran liegts?Dabei gelten gerade sie als Ruckgrat der deutschen Wirtschaft. Doch viele Betriebe leiden unter langsamem Internet, mussen Mitarbeitenden digitales Know-how vermitteln - und stehen gleichzeitig vor teuren Investitionen.Warum schreitet die Digitalisierung im Mittelstand so zah voran? Wer verhindert den Fortschritt - und was hatte langst geschehen sein mussen, damit Deutschlands Wirtschaftsmotor nicht ins Stottern kommt? In der "WISO"-Doku "Update uberfallig. Wie digital ist die Wirtschaft?" geht ZDF-Wirtschaftsexperte Florian Neuhann den Ursachen des digitalen Stillstands auf den Grund.Liegt das Hauptproblem in der Politik? Viele Jahre fehlte eine klare Digitalstrategie. Erst im Mai diesen Jahres wurde unter der neuen Regierung das Bundesministerium fur Digitales geschaffen - mit Karsten Wildberger (CDU) als erstem Digitalminister uberhaupt. Ein Schritt mit Symbolkraft, aber reichen neue Plane und Versprechen aus? Florian Neuhann trifft den Minister und geht der Frage nach, ob der digitale Aufbruch nun wirklich gelingt - oder wieder an alten Strukturen zu scheitern droht.Auch viele Unternehmen mussen sich fragen, welchen Anteil sie selbst am schleppenden Tempo haben. Zu oft hieSS es in der Vergangenheit: "Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht." Doch ein Umdenken findet zunehmend statt - spatestens seit der Corona-Pandemie investieren mittelstandische Unternehmen immer mehr in digitale Projekte. 2024 waren es knapp 32 Milliarden Euro. Allerdings profitieren vor allem groSSere Betriebe. Kleinere Unternehmen bleiben oft zuruck - ihnen fehlt es an Ressourcen, Personal und finanzieller Planungssicherheit, um digitale Vorhaben wirklich umzusetzen.Der Film von Anja KollruSS und Kim Uhlich zeigt, wie Mittelstandler zwischen Aufbruch und Abwarten stehen. Sie begleiten Unternehmen, die sich Schritt fur Schritt voran tasten - und solche, die schon mitten im Wandel stecken. Zwischen technischen Hurden, rechtlichen Unsicherheiten und begrenzten Ressourcen stellt sich immer wieder die gleiche Frage: Was braucht es, damit Digitalisierung nicht langer ein Projekt bleibt - sondern wirklich im Alltag ankommt?Die "WISO"-Dokumentation erklart, warum Digitalisierung im deutschen Mittelstand Chance und Herausforderung zugleich bedeutet. Neben einem Gesprach mit dem Bundesdigitalminister Karsten Wildberger trifft ZDF-Journalist Florian Neuhann fur diesen Film die Managerin Julia Jakel, die Digitalexpertin Aya Jaff und Andrea Thoma-Bock von der "Initiative Zukunft Wirtschaft Deutschland".

programme.desc: Episode: Christos Nikolopoulos. Η εκκλησία, το καφενείο και το ποδοσφαιρικό γήπεδο. Η εκπομπή εστιάζει στους ποδοσφαιριστές που αγωνίζονται για το χειροκρότημα και την τιμή του χωριού και της φανέλας.

programme.title: Perimeter (e) / Περίμετρος (Ε)
programme.desc: An informative broadcast that focuses daily on the news and on specific issues, in concentric circles, with a focus on Thessaloniki, the regions of the country, our neighboring countries and the community. / Ενημερωτική εκπομπή η οποία επικεντρώνει καθημερινά στην επικαιρότητα και σε ειδικά θέματα, σε ομόκεντρους κύκλους, με έμφαση τη Θεσσαλονίκη, τις περιφέρειες της χώρας, τις γειτονικές μας χώρες και την Ομογένεια.

programme.title: But how is it made? E8 (e) / Μα Πώς Φτιάχνεται; Ε8 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: aluminum boxes. George is looking for how to make the boxes of soft drinks and beer. He answers knowledge questions and visits a factory where aluminum boxes are manufactured. / Επεισόδιο: Κουτάκια Αλουμινίου. Ο Γιώργος αναζητά πώς φτιάχνονται τα κουτάκια αναψυκτικών και μπίρας. Απαντά σε ερωτήσεις γνώσεων και επισκέπτεται ένα εργοστάσιο όπου κατασκευάζονται τα αλουμινένια κουτάκια.

programme.title: Brilliant ancient cities E4 (e) / Λαμπρές Αρχαίες Πόλεις Ε4 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Rome. Thanks to shocking representations with computer images, this documentary takes us to the discovery of Rome, the most important and most excellent city of the ancient world. / Επεισόδιο: Ρώμη. Χάρη σε συγκλονιστικές αναπαραστάσεις με εικόνες μέσω υπολογιστή, αυτό το ντοκιμαντέρ μάς ταξιδεύει στην ανακάλυψη της Ρώμης, της σπουδαιότερης και πιο εξαιρετικής πόλης του αρχαίου κόσμου.

programme.title: Concert in the heart of Amsterdam, Harding and Kavakos (E) / Συναυλία στην Καρδιά του Άμστερνταμ, Χάρντινγκ and Καβάκος (Ε)
programme.desc: On September 10, 2021, the Royal Orchestra of the Netherlands, Concertgebouworkest, opened the season with a festive concert in the heart of Amsterdam. Daniel Harding directs a musical journey with the world -renowned violinist, Leonidas Kavakos. / Στις 10 Σεπτεμβρίου 2021, η Βασιλική Ορχήστρα της Ολλανδίας, Concertgebouworkest, άνοιξε τη σεζόν με μια εορταστική συναυλία στην καρδιά του Άμστερνταμ. Ο Ντάνιελ Χάρντινγκ διευθύνει ένα μουσικό ταξίδι με σολίστ τον παγκοσμίου φήμης βιολιστή, Λεωνίδα Καβάκο.

programme.title: Overheating in the Mediterranean (E) / Υπερθέρμανση στη Μεσόγειο (Ε)
programme.desc: The program presents the deep changes brought about by global warming in the Mediterranean, the sea described as Oinop Pontos, and in the surrounding areas. / Το πρόγραμμα παρουσιάζει τις βαθιές αλλαγές που έφερε η υπερθέρμανση του πλανήτη στη Μεσόγειο, τη θάλασσα που περιέγραψε ως Οίνωψ Πόντος ο Όμηρος, και στις γύρω περιοχές.

programme.title: Above all the project: Tribute to Nikos Kazantzakis (E) / Πάνω απ Όλα το Έργο: Αφιέρωμα στον Νίκο Καζαντζάκη (Ε)
programme.desc: Researchers, university professors, who dealt with the great Cretan and worldwide creator, as well as ordinary everyday people, tell stories that lived and listened, outlining his life and work. / Ερευνητές, καθηγητές πανεπιστημίου, που ασχολήθηκαν με τον μεγάλο Κρητικό και παγκόσμιο δημιουργό, αλλά και απλοί καθημερινοί άνθρωποι, αφηγούνται ιστορίες που έζησαν και άκουσαν, σκιαγραφώντας τη ζωή και το έργο του.

programme.title: 45 craftsmen, 60 pupils K2 E6 (E) / 45 Μάστοροι, 60 Μαθητάδες Κ2 Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The art of copper in Kozani. We visit the workshop of a family practicing the art of copper in Kozani exploring new opportunities and markets, but without moving away from traditional techniques. / Επεισόδιο: Η Τέχνη του Χαλκουργού στην Κοζάνη. Επισκεπτόμαστε το εργαστήριο μιας οικογένειας που ασκεί την τέχνη του χαλκουργού στην Κοζάνη εξερευνώντας νέες ευκαιρίες και αγορές, δίχως όμως να απομακρύνεται από τις παραδοσιακές τεχνικές.

programme.title: Borders (e) / Σύνορα (Ε)
programme.desc: We cross the border to discover daily issues related to the southeast of Europe. / Περνάμε τα σύνορα για να ανακαλύψουμε θέματα που αφορούν την καθημερινότητα στις χώρες της ΝΑ Ευρώπης.

programme.title: Co-Officers K4 E7 (E) / Συν-Άνθρωποι Κ4 Ε7 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: In the flow of feasible. On the outskirts of the city. A stream that continues. Giannis Darras follows a group of young people on a rare and difficult journey: from Goudi to Kallimarmaro, in the galleries of covered Ilissos. / Επεισόδιο: Στη Ροή του Εφικτού. Στα έγκατα της πόλης. Ένα ρέμα που συνεχίζει. Ο Γιάννης Δάρρας ακολουθεί μια ομάδα νέων ανθρώπων σε μια σπάνια και δύσκολη διαδρομή: από το Γουδί μέχρι το Καλλιμάρμαρο, μέσα στις στοές του καλυμμένου Ιλισού.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Sunday in the village again (e) / Κυριακή στο Χωριό Ξανά (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Vervena Arcadia. Brand new idea on traditional show. The village remains the protagonist, the people who inhabit it, their lives, the way they reproduce their traditions, everything they have achieved in time and everything they dream of. / Επεισόδιο: Βέρβενα Αρκαδίας. Ολοκαίνουργια ιδέα πάνω στην παραδοσιακή εκπομπή. Πρωταγωνιστής παραμένει το χωριό, οι άνθρωποι που το κατοικούν, οι ζωές τους, ο τρόπος που αναπαράγουν τις παραδόσεις τους, όλα όσα έχουν πετύχει μέσα στο χρόνο κι όλα όσα ονειρεύονται.

programme.title: From the field to the shelf K1 E13 (E) / Από το Χωράφι στο Ράφι Κ1 Ε13 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Watermelon. We travel to Achaia and Ilia, where more than 30,000 acres are cultivated outdoor and greenhouse watermelon, covering internal demand and overseas markets and are informed about the most popular varieties. / Επεισόδιο: Καρπούζι. Ταξιδεύουμε στην Αχαΐα και την Ηλεία, όπου καλλιεργούνται πάνω από 30.000 στρέμματα υπαίθριο και θερμοκηπιακό καρπούζι, καλύπτοντας την εσωτερική ζήτηση και τις αγορές του εξωτερικού και ενημερωνόμαστε για τις πιο δημοφιλείς ποικιλίες.

programme.title: Green Stories K3 E8 (E) / Πράσινες Ιστορίες Κ3 Ε8 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Kirkinezi - Nileas. We talk to environmentalist Konstantinos Vlachopoulos about Kirkinezi and the state of his population in Greece. We then travel to the country of Messinia, where we learn about the Nilea producers team and its action. / Επεισόδιο: Κιρκινέζι - Νηλέας. Συνομιλούμε με τον περιβαλλοντολόγο Κωνσταντίνο Βλαχόπουλο για το κιρκινέζι και την κατάσταση του πληθυσμού του στην Ελλάδα. Στη συνέχεια, ταξιδεύουμε στη Χώρα Μεσσηνίας, όπου μαθαίνουμε για την Ομάδα Παραγωγών Νηλέας και τη δράση της.

programme.title: Greek events (e) / Ελλήνων Δρώμενα (Ε)
programme.desc: I. Skordalos-My Lyre Friends. Surrounded by lyricist, composer and lyricist with dozens of successes, Thanasis Skordalos opened new paths to musical expression and folk Cretan idiom and decisively influenced all the creators of the island. / Θ. Σκορδαλός-Της Λύρας μου οι Φίλοι. Επιδέξιος λυράρης, συνθέτης και στιχουργός µε δεκάδες επιτυχίες, ο Θανάσης Σκορδαλός, άνοιξε νέους δρόμους στη μουσική έκφραση και στο λαϊκό Κρητικό ιδίωμα και επηρέασε καθοριστικά το σύνολο των δημιουργών του νησιού.

programme.title: Islands on the edge E3 (e) / Νησιά στην Άκρη Ε3 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Archo. A short distance from the Turkish coasts and near Patmos, there is a cluster of small islands belonging to the Dodecanese. This tiny and unknown Polynesia also belongs to the Arkians. / Επεισόδιο: Αρκιοί. Σε μικρή απόσταση από τις τουρκικές ακτές και κοντά στην Πάτμο, υπάρχει ένα σύμπλεγμα μικρών νησιών που ανήκουν στα Δωδεκάνησα. Σε αυτήν τη μικροσκοπική και άγνωστη Πολυνησία ανήκουν και οι Αρκιοί.

programme.title: News from the Region / Ειδήσεις από την Περιφέρεια
programme.desc: Find out about all the latest news from the region. / Ενημερωθείτε για όλα τα τελευταία νέα από την περιφέρεια.

programme.title: Musikology E10 (E) / Musikology Ε10 (Ε)
programme.desc: Fotis explains to us the Doppler phenomenon and we learn about the music of the country that has won 7 times Eurovision, Sweden! We are talking with saxophonist Melina Paxinou and the famous pianist, George Kontrafouris. / Ο Φώτης μάς εξηγεί το φαινόμενο Doppler και μαθαίνουμε για τη μουσική της χώρας που έχει κερδίσει 7 φορές τη Eurovision, την Σουηδία! Μιλάμε με τη σαξοφωνίστρια Μελίνα Παξινού και με τον διάσημο πιανίστα, Γιώργο Κοντραφούρη.

programme.title: The altar of Pergamon, a looted monument (e) / O Βωμός της Περγάμου, Ένα Λεηλατημένο Μνημείο (Ε)
programme.desc: In 1864, a German engineer discovered the ruins of a lost miracle of the world, the altar of Pergamon, to the west of the Ottoman Empire. Berlin wanted what was left for its museum island. And he got it! / Το 1864, ένας Γερμανός μηχανικός ανακάλυψε τα ερείπια ενός χαμένου θαύματος του κόσμου, του Βωμού της Περγάμου, στα δυτικά της Οθωμανικής Αυτοκρατορίας. Το Βερολίνο ήθελε ό,τι είχε απομείνει για το Νησί των Μουσείων του. Και το πήρε!

programme.title: My name is Elias Kazan / Το Όνομά μου Είναι Ελία Καζάν
programme.desc: PREMIERE. 1972: Kazan presents his latest film, visitors, in Cannes. Andre Lambart decide to follow him in the US ... 2017: Lamcart decides to shoot a film with these anecdotal interviews. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. 1972: Ο Καζάν παρουσιάζει την τελευταία του ταινία, Οι Επισκέπτες, στις Κάννες. Ο Αντρέ Λαμπάρτ αποφασίζουν να τον ακολουθήσουν στις ΗΠΑ... 2017: Ο Λαμπάρτ αποφασίζει να γυρίσει μια ταινία με αυτές τις ανέκδοτες συνεντεύξεις.

programme.title: Nationwide / Πανελλήνιον
programme.desc: PREMIERE. A story of ghosts about obsession, loneliness and madness, in a chess coffee shop out of place and time, in downtown Athens: This is the story of the Panhellenic. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Μια ιστορία φαντασμάτων για την εμμονή, τη μοναξιά και την τρέλα, σε ένα σκακιστικό καφενείο εκτός τόπου και χρόνου, στο κέντρο της Αθήνας: αυτή είναι η ιστορία για το Πανελλήνιον.

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: The armchair on the sidewalk. A song brings youthful memories to an elderly retired retired dementia. Longing to regain his independence, he leaves home secretly from his wife, defying the doctor's instructions. / Η Πολυθρόνα στο Πεζοδρόμιο. Ένα τραγούδι ανασύρει νεανικές μνήμες σε έναν ηλικιωμένο συνταξιούχο που πάσχει από άνοια. Λαχταρώντας να επανακτήσει την ανεξαρτησία του, φεύγει από το σπίτι κρυφά από τη σύζυγό του, αψηφώντας τις οδηγίες του γιατρού.

programme.title: Small stories / Μικρές Ιστορίες
programme.desc: The house on Pagalou Street. The son returns to his birthday city, his first school, to the summer cinema, to the events that marked him as a child, in his father's home. / Το Σπίτι στην Οδό Παγκάλου. Ο γιος επιστρέφει στη γενέθλια πόλη, στο πρώτο του σχολείο, στο θερινό σινεμά, στα γεγονότα που τον σημάδεψαν ως παιδί, στο πατρικό του σπίτι.

programme.desc: Episode: Notia Africa, The Leopard Road. As we take the road to find a mythical beast, the leopard, this film leads us to an adventurous treasure hunt in South Africa. / Επεισόδιο: Nότια Αφρική, ο Δρόμος της Λεοπάρδαλης. Καθώς παίρνουμε τον δρόμο για να βρούμε ένα μυθικό θηρίο, τη λεοπάρδαλη, αυτή η ταινία μας οδηγεί σε ένα περιπετειώδες κυνήγι θησαυρού στη Νότια Αφρική.

programme.title: The secrets of the enchanted K1 E6 (E) Forestry / Τα Μυστικά των Μαγεμένων Δασών Κ1 Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Extreme conditions. Discover how plants and animals live in the dryest areas of the earth. Watch insects that work with plants to survive and discover the chemical war raging in nature. / Επεισόδιο: Ακραίες Συνθήκες. Ανακαλύψτε πώς φυτά και ζώα διαβιούν στις πιο ξηρές περιοχές της Γης. Παρακολουθήστε έντομα που συνεργάζονται με φυτά για να επιβιώσουν και ανακαλύψτε τον χημικό πόλεμο που μαίνεται στη φύση.

programme.title: Villages of Alps K2 E3 / Χωριά των Άλπεων Κ2 Ε3
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: The Alps of the Tox. Shiny, mountain lakes, snowy and imposing peaks. From the capital of the state, Innsbruck, the Vistral Valley and its side valleys extend between the alps of the Alps. / ΠΡΕΜΙΕΡΑ. Επεισόδιο: Οι Άλπεις του Τουξ. Λαμπερές, ορεινές λίμνες, χιονισμένες και επιβλητικές κορυφές. Από την πρωτεύουσα του κρατιδίου, το Ίνσμπρουκ, εκτείνεται η κοιλάδα Βίπταλ και οι παράπλευρες κοιλάδες της ανάμεσα στις κορυφές των Άλπεων του Τουξ.

programme.title: Day with color / Μέρα με Χρώμα
programme.desc: Informative magazine with emphasis on culture, sciences, environment and entrepreneurship. With direct connections, guests and reports, the show highlights issues that concern the citizens of Thessaloniki. / Ενημερωτικό μαγκαζίνο με έμφαση στον πολιτισμό, τις επιστήμες, το περιβάλλον και την επιχειρηματικότητα. Με απευθείας συνδέσεις, προσκεκλημένους και ρεπορτάζ, η εκπομπή αναδεικνύει θέματα που απασχολούν τους πολίτες της Θεσσαλονίκης.

programme.title: The vineyards of the world E6 (e) / Οι Αμπελώνες του Κόσμου Ε6 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: A trip to the beginning of the vineyard. Here the wine is sacred! At the foot of the Grand Caucasus, Georgia has a secret of thousands of years, which is trying to reveal to the world. Vineyards and wine are said to have started here six thousand years ago. / Επεισόδιο: Ένα Ταξίδι στις Απαρχές του Αμπελιού. Εδώ το κρασί είναι ιερό! Στους πρόποδες του Μεγάλου Καυκάσου, η Γεωργία διατηρεί ένα μυστικό χιλιάδων ετών, το οποίο προσπαθεί να αποκαλύψει στον κόσμο. Τα αμπέλια και το κρασί λέγεται ότι ξεκίνησαν εδώ πριν από έξι χιλιάδες χρόνια.

programme.desc: Enjoy with a musical program that brings us recordings of various, musical concerts. / Uživajte uz muzički program koji nam donosi snimke raznih, muzičkih koncerata.

programme.title: My year I am a selinder / Moja godina sam Selindžerom
programme.desc: Joen graduated in law and received a job in the agency that represents the famous but withdrawn writer Selinger. / Džoen je taze diplomirala i dobila posao u agenciji koja zastupa poznatog, ali povučenog pisca Selindžera.

programme.title: Podkast: We are still green / Podkast: Još smo mi zeleni
programme.desc: The emission dedicated to young people, intended to educate and present young people in Montenegro a new angle of viewing on their environment and the world. / Emisija posvećena mladima, namijenjena da obrazuje i prikaže mladima u Crnoj Gori novi ugao gledanja na njihovu okolinu i svijet.

programme.title: Music industry / Muzička industrija
programme.desc: The "music industry" is a show that brings interesting stories about music, musicians and musical events. / "Muzička industrija" je emisija koja donosi zanimljive priče o muzici, muzičarima i muzičkim događajima.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: Follow the Dnevnik 2, one of the central, information broadcasters of Montenegro and find out all the most important news. / Pratite Dnevnik 2, jednu od centralnih, informativnih emisija Radio Televizije Crne Gore i saznajte sve najvažnije vijesti.

programme.title: Automotive: "Clio Cup" - Valencia / Automobilizam: "Clio cup" - Valensija
programme.desc: Renault Clio Cup is a series of car racing of this famous French car brand. Enjoy an exciting competition in which drivers of this popular model participate, which has been declared a few times for the best European car! / Renault Clio Cup je serija trka automobila ovog poznatog francuskog automobilskog brenda. Uživajte u uzbudljivom takmičenju na kom učestvuju vozači ovog popularnog modela, koji je nekoliko puta proglašavan za najbolji evropski automobil!

programme.title: Good morning black goro / Dobro jutro Crna Goro
programme.desc: Start the day with us! Perfect compound for good morning! / Počnite dan sa nama! Savršen spoj za dobro jutro!

programme.title: I play my game / Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Bestial sensuality: need to procreate / Sensualidade Bestial: Necessidade de Procriar
programme.desc: Motivated by a liberation of hormones, all creatures on the planet, large or small, do everything it takes to find and secure a partner. For some it will be the combat of their lives, others have to improve, display, and give a party to be successful. From casual encounters and group sex to eternal love and unbreakable ties, the animal kingdom has everything. For these sensual animals there is no primitive instinct stronger than the need to procreate. Camels drool over partners available, the birds-vitória-vitória birds organize a dance competition and, in the society of Bonobos, or chimpanzes-pigmean, worth practically everything! But be it conflict, love, or a mixture of the two the way to a partner, the transmission of the DNA and a vital part of the journey of nature ... and there is always a remarkable story to tell. / Motivadas por uma libertaçao de hormonas, todas as criaturas do planeta, grandes ou pequenas, farao tudo o que for preciso para encontrar e garantir um parceiro. Para alguns será o combate das suas vidas, já outros terao de se aprimorar, exibir, e dar uma festa para serem bem-sucedidos. Desde encontros casuais e sexo em grupo ao amor eterno e laços inquebráveis, o reino animal tem de tudo. Para estes animais sensuais nao há instinto primitivo mais forte do que a necessidade de procriar. Os camelos babam-se por parceiros disponíveis, as aves-do-paraíso-rainha-vitoria organizam uma competiçao de dança e, na sociedade dos bonobos, ou chimpanzes-pigmeu, vale praticamente tudo! Mas, seja conflito, amor, ou uma mistura dos dois o caminho para um parceiro, a transmissao do ADN e uma parte vital da jornada da natureza... e há sempre uma historia notável para contar.

programme.title: Beauty UFC 319 / MMA UFC 319
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Martial Sport - MMA: Petrovic Vs Kalaba / Borilački sport - MMA: Petrovic vs Kalaba
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Football - Europa League / Fudbal - Liga Evrope
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Zrinjski - Sarajevo / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Zrinjski - Sarajevo
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Chat by coffee / Klepet ob kavi
programme.desc: Open the treasure trove of interesting ideas, ideas and information that Jasmina Kandorfer surrenders together with interesting guests on the show Chat Ob coffee. In each show, they address several topical topics that relate to health, personal growth and spirituality. The creators of the show are at the same time researchers who devote themselves to both old wisdom and contemporary approaches. They believe in good stories and exceptional people, so in each show we will be able to listen to interesting personalities and their experience and life stories. / Odprite zakladnico zanimivih zamisli, idej in informacij, ki jih Jasmina Kandorfer predaja skupaj z zanimivimi gosti v oddaji Klepet ob kavi. V vsaki oddaji obravnavajo več aktualnih tematik, ki se navezujejo na zdravje, osebnostno rast in duhovnost. Ustvarjalci oddaje so hkrati raziskovalci, ki se posvečajo tako starim modrostim kot sodobnim pristopom. Verjamejo v dobre zgodbe in izjemne ljudi, zato bomo v vsaki oddaji lahko prisluhnili zanimivim osebnostim ter njihovim izkušnjam in življenjskim zgodbam.

programme.title: Dynasty / Dinastija
programme.desc: The mighty oil mogul Blake Carrington is preparing for a wedding with Young KRYSTLE JENNINGS, his former secretary. The Black KRYSTLE family accepts cold, and the staff also look at it, and Black's stubborn and promiscuous daughter resent her. Although he is committed to Krystle, Blake devotes a lot more time and attention to his company Denver-Carrington, so he doesn't even notice what Krystle is facing. Her only ally is Black's son, Steven, who, however, does not understand with her father, because of his different political views. / Mogočen naftni mogotec Blake Carrington se pripravlja na poroko z mlado Krystle Jennings, svojo nekdanjo tajnico. Blakova družina Krystle sprejme hladno, tudi osebje nanjo gleda zviška, Blakova trmasta in promiskuitetna hči pa ji zameri. Čeprav je predan Krystle, Blake veliko več časa in pozornosti namenja svojemu podjetju Denver-Carrington, zato niti ne opazi, s čim vse se Krystle sooča. Njen edini zaveznik je Blakov sin, Steven, ki pa se z očetom, zaradi različnih političnih pogledov, ne razume najbolje.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Football (M): Olympia - Bravo, first League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Olimpija - Bravo, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Despite repeated experiments, she in no way manages to remove this shiny skyscraper from her husband and turn it back into ordinary detention. Original title: Heavenly production: 2021 state: co -producer: black comedy: Srdjan Dragojevic's: Srdjan Dragojevic Grad. Timotijevic. / Za pokušino samo prva zgodba. A vsa ta nezaželena pozornost sosedov ni prav nič všeč njegovi odločni ženi. Kljub večkratnim poskusom ji nikakor ne uspe odstraniti tega sijočega nebodigatreba s svojega moža in ga spremeniti nazaj v navadno puščobo. programme.title: Freemasons, thorn in the fifth dictators, Italian documentary series, 2/2, Mon. / Prostozidarji, trn v peti diktatorjev, italijanska dokumentarna serija, 2/2, pon.
programme.sub-title: Dictators Nightmare; Prostozidarska bratovščina je bila uradno ustanovljena na začetku 18. stoletja v Londonu, po nekaterih podatkih pa je obstajala že veliko prej. Delovanje te organizacije je že od nekdaj zavito v tančico skrivnosti. Dokumentarna seri
programme.desc: Part 2: Of the three major European dictators of the 20th century - Mussolini, Franz and Hitler - the German Firer was the one who persecuted Freemasons the most fervent. It began with the search for the culprits for the defeat of Germany in World War I. Already during the failed Hitler coup in 1923, Jews and Freemasons were proclaimed racial enemies of the German nation, and Hitler mentioned in his work my struggle a Jewish-Post-Inspiration. In 1935 he closed the German Freemasonry Lodge, and continued the persecution of Brotherhood members during World War II, not only in Germany, but also in occupied countries, including France and Belgium. After the occupation of Paris, the Nazis destroyed the main French Freemasonry Lodge. Thousands of Freemasons ended in concentration camps, where they sought to preserve their customs and secret rituals.Dictators Nightmare / Italy / 2022 / Director: Luigi Maria Perotti. / 2. del:Od treh velikih evropskih diktatorjev 20. stoletja – Mussolinija, Franca in Hitlerja – je bil nemški firer tisti, ki je prostozidarje preganjal najbolj zagrizeno. Začelo se je z iskanjem krivcev za poraz Nemčije v prvi svetovni vojni. Že v času spodletelega Hitlerjevega puča leta 1923 so Jude in prostozidarje razglasili za rasne sovražnike nemškega naroda, Hitler pa je v svojem delu Moj boj omenil judovsko-prostozidarsko zaroto. Leta 1935 je dal zapreti nemške prostozidarske lože, preganjanje članov bratovščine pa je nadaljeval tudi med drugo svetovno vojno, ne le v Nemčiji, temveč tudi v zasedenih državah, med drugim v Franciji in Belgiji. Po zasedbi Pariza so nacisti razdejali poslopje glavne francoske prostozidarske lože. Na tisoče prostozidarjev je končalo v koncentracijskih taboriščih, kjer so si prizadevali ohraniti svoje običaje in skrivne obrede.DICTATORS NIGHTMARE / Italija / 2022 / Režija: Luigi Maria Perotti.

programme.title: Video night / Videonoč
We predict / Napovedujemo
Memories: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 3. Part, Mon. / Spomini: prof. dr. Niko Toš, 3. del, pon.
programme.desc: Lawyer and sociologist prof. dr. Nika Tosh is known by many generations of students of the Faculty of Social Sciences, and is known to the general public as the founder and head of the Center for Research of Public Opinion and Mass Communications. The first two of the four parts of the show are, through his memories and the memories of his ancestors, interesting Chronicle of Life in Slovenia in the last century on his life path from Maribor through Celje to Ljubljana, among personalities whose stories (even with valuable documentary recordings) are involved in the narrative, and are also the colonel of the royal army Draz Mihailov, Wife, sculptor Karl Bulovcev, uncle and aunt Nika Tosh, the Mrak family, from which Tosh's mother, painter and Olympian Toso Primožič and many others come from. The third and fourth parts of the memories of Nika Tosh are dedicated to the development of Slovenian and Yugoslav society through the findings of public opinion polls, and again the entire Gallery of Slovenian, Yugoslav and European figures in this field is involved in the narrative. Today, the eighty -year -old annual professor Niko Toš is an outstanding storyteller and a weighty thoughtful about society and time we live, so it is definitely worth listening to. / Pravnika in sociologa prof. dr. Nika Toša poznajo mnoge generacije študentov Fakultete za družbene vede, širša javnost pa ga pozna kot ustanovitelja in predstojnika Centra za raziskovanje javnega mnenja in množičnih komunikacij. Prva dva od štirih delov oddaje sta skozi njegove spomine ter spomine njegovih prednikov zanimiva kronika življenja na Slovenskem v zadnjem stoletju na njegovi življenjski poti od Maribora prek Celja v Ljubljano, med osebnostmi, katerih zgodbe se (tudi z dragocenimi dokumentarnimi posnetki) vpletajo v pripoved, pa so tudi polkovnik kraljeve vojske Draža Mihailovič, major Mirko Bitenc, pisatelj in dramatik Ivan Mrak in njegova žena, kiparka Karla Bulovčeva, stric in teta Nika Toša, družina Mrak, iz katere izhaja Toševa mama, slikar in olimpijec Tošo Primožič in mnogi drugi. Tretji in četrti del Spominov Nika Toša sta posvečena razvoju slovenske in jugoslovanske družbe skozi izsledke raziskav javnega mnenja in spet se v pripoved vpleta cela galerija slovenskih, jugoslovanskih in evropskih osebnosti s tega področja. Danes oseminosemdesetletni letni profesor Niko Toš je izjemen pripovednik in tehten premišljevalec o družbi in času, ki ga živimo, zato mu je vsekakor vredno prisluhniti.

programme.title: We use wood, part 6. / Uporabimo les, 6. del, izobraževalno-dokumentarna oddaja, pon.
programme.desc: Use wood, 6. Part; Wood is not just a building material. With it, we bring nature into our home and it is proven that wood improves well -being and productivity. Wood offers development opportunities for businesses and individuals and is a strategic material of our country, which makes Slovenia ranks among the three most forested European countries. Let's listen to the inspiring stories of people who passionately believe in the charm of wood and see the material of the future, an opportunity for economic development and the preservation of the environment for future generations. / Uporabimo Les, 6. Del; Les ni le gradbeni material. Z njim vnašamo naravo v svoj dom in dokazano je, da les izboljšuje počutje in storilnost. Les ponuja razvojne priložnosti tako podjetjem kot posameznikom in je strateški material naše države, zaradi katerega se Slovenija uvršča med tri najbolj gozdnate evropske države. Prisluhnimo navdihujočim zgodbam ljudi, ki strastno verjamejo v čar lesa in v njem vidijo material prihodnosti, priložnost za gospodarski razvoj in ohranitev okolja za prihodnje generacije.

programme.title: Siddharta in Stožice Arena, 2. Del, Concert, Mon. / Siddharta v Areni Stožice, 2. del, koncert, pon.
programme.desc: The Siddharte Concert was sold to the screens, recorded on November 18, 2023 at the Stožice Arena in Ljubljana. 30 years after the legendary concert at the Bežigrad Stadium and the release of the Rh- album. Visitors, the media and the professional public are united that this concert - just as Siddharta is customary - has moved the boundaries of concert and stage production. The inspiring program, which lasts almost three and a half hours, contains the biggest hits and also the songs of the latest album X. The concert will premiere on TV Slovenia in two parts. / Na ekrane prihaja razprodani koncert Siddharte, posnet 18. novembra 2023 v ljubljanski Areni Stožice. 30 let po legendarnem koncertu na bežigrajskem stadionu in izidu albuma Rh-. Obiskovalci, mediji in strokovna javnost so enotni, da je tokratni koncert – tako kot je pri Siddharti že v navadi – premaknil meje koncertne in odrske produkcije. Navdušujoč program, ki traja skoraj tri ure in pol, vsebuje največje uspešnice in tudi pesmi najnovejšega albuma X. Koncert bo premierno na TV Slovenija predvajan v dveh delih.

programme.desc: R: Bastič Aljaž ... In the Studio of Television Slovenia, with selected works, young musicians present themselves in their study path and warn themselves with excellent performances. With the piano accompaniment of Alvin Ćućić, she introduced herself with the performance of Rahmanin's vocalis and dancing of the green devil of Spanish composer Gaspar Cassado, and played an interesting work of contemporary Sicilian composer Giovannni Sollime on the stage. / R: Bastič Aljaž... V studiu Televizije Slovenija se z izbranimi deli predstavljajo mladi glasbeniki, ki na svoji študijski poti dosegajo izjemne uspehe in opozarjajo nase z odličnimi nastopi. Violončelistka Ema Krečič po končanem študiju na Akademiji za glasbo v Ljubljani svoje znanje izpopolnjuje na salzburški glasbeni univerzi Mozarteum. programme.title: Environments, pom. / Ambienti, pon.
programme.sub-title: Ambienti; Mlad par si je ustvaril svoj sanjski dom v novogradnji na očarljivem Bledu. Pot od iskanja idealne lokacije do končne ureditve doma ni bila kratka, vendar dom zdaj popolnoma odraža njune želje po udobju in estetiki. Spoznamo, kako sta se sooča
programme.desc: We show an apartment in Portorož that goes beyond the boundaries of countries and combines people with a vision of beauty and harmony. The background of harmonious chaos consists of artistic pieces from all over the world - from Iran and Uzbekistan all the way to local antiques. The owner explains how she succeeded in subtly combining the stories of the past with modernity and what role her partner plays. Although dry meadows above the Karst edge are considered to be the most colorful collection of meadow flowers, just below it is a beautiful garden, completely hidden from the rare visitors of the village of Podpeč. His creator kindly received us and took us around her stone home, surrounded by dehuminous roses, fruit trees and countless flowers. / Pokažemo stanovanje v Portorožu, ki presega meje držav ter združuje ljudi z vizijo lepote in harmonije. Ozadje harmoničnega kaosa sestavljajo umetniški kosi z vseh koncev sveta - od Irana in Uzbekistana pa vse do lokalnih starinarnic. Lastnica razloži, kako ji je uspelo subtilno združiti zgodbe preteklosti s sodobnostjo in kakšno vlogo pri tem igra njen partner.Čeprav veljajo suhi travniki nad Kraškim robom za najbolj pisano zbirko travniških cvetlic, se tik pod njim skriva čudovit vrt, povsem skrit očem redkih obiskovalcev vasi Podpeč. Njegova ustvarjalka nas je prijazno sprejela in popeljala okoli svojega kamnitega doma, obdanega z dehtečimi vrtnicami, sadnimi drevesi in neštetimi cvetovi.

S kamero spremljamo domača in mednarodna tekmovanja, v katerih se za najvišja mesta merijo tudi Slovenci. V prispevkih tudi o pomenu športa za invalide. Prav šport je tisti most socializacije, ki (mladim) invalidom izboljšuje kakovost življenja.

programme.title: European Wonder (II): Florence Cathedral - Renaissance Sciences, French Documentary Series, 3/4 / Čudesa Evrope (II.): Firenška stolnica – znanilka renesanse, francoska dokumentarna serija, 3/4
programme.sub-title: The Wonders Of Europe / Leurope Des Merveilles Ii.; Druga sezona dokumentarne serije Čudesa Evrope razkriva zgodovino štirih edinstvenih evropskih znamenitosti: Eifflovega stolpa, firenške stolnice, rimskega Panteona in veličastnega dvorca Schonbrunn na
programme.desc: Part 3.: Florence Cathedral - A Sciences Renaissasetreti Delo reveals the stunning history of one of the most famous churches of all time, the Florence Cathedral. In 1418, a competition for the construction of the largest dome, which the world has seen before, were announced in Florence. The cathedral in this famous city, the then economic capital of Europe, has been an unfinished for over a hundred years. This shameful conundrum was finally dismissed by Filippo Brunelleschi, after which the greatest masters later looked at Leonardo Da Vinci and Michelangelo. Initially, a completely unknown genius created one of the greatest cultural treasures of all time, the mighty dome of the Santa Maria del Fiore Cathedral, which is still admired by the whole world today.The Wonders of Europe II. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Dominique Fargues. / 3. del: Firenška stolnica – znanilka renesanseTretji del razkriva osupljivo zgodovino ene najznamenitejših cerkva vseh časov, firenške stolnice. Leta 1418 so v Firencah razpisali natečaj za gradnjo največje kupole, kar jih je dotlej videl svet. Stolnica v tem slovitem mestu, tedanji gospodarski prestolnici Evrope, je namreč že več kot sto let stala nedokončana. To sramotno zagato je nazadnje razrešil Filippo Brunelleschi, po katerem so se pozneje zgledovali največji mojstri, vključno z Leonardom da Vincijem in Michelangelom. Sprva še povsem neznani genij je ustvaril enega največjih kulturnih zakladov vseh časov, mogočno kupolo katedrale Santa Maria del Fiore, ki jo še danes občuduje ves svet.THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Dominique Fargues.

programme.title: Evening News Weekend / Telenotícies vespre cap de setmana
programme.desc: Ramon Pellicer and Cristina Riba are responsible for sending the most prominent information in the evening edition of the weekend's news program. / Ramon Pellicer i Cristina Riba son els encarregats de fer arribar les informacions mes destacades en l’edicio del vespre del Telenotícies del cap de setmana.

programme.title: Widows / Viudes
programme.desc: Four women with nothing in common, except the debt inherited by the criminal activities of their deceased husbands, decide to take the reins of their destination and conspire to force a future with their own rules. On this occasion, the filmmaker moves the action of the London from the early 80s to the contemporary Chicago to tell a story about four women of different levels - racial, social and economic - that join forces to achieve a common goal. / Cuatro mujeres sin nada en común, excepto la deuda heredada por las actividades criminales de sus difuntos maridos, deciden tomar las riendas de su destino y conspiran para forjarse un futuro con sus propias reglas.Cinco años despues de ganar el Oscar con 12 años de esclavitud, Steve McQueen estreno este thriller dramático basado en la serie de television británica de 1983 Las viudas. En esta ocasion, el realizador traslada la accion del Londres de principios de los 80 al Chicago contemporáneo para narrar una historia sobre cuatro mujeres de distintos estamentos -racial, social y economico- que unen fuerzas para conseguir un objetivo común.

programme.title: The collective / El col·lectiu
programme.desc: A young man recruits from a mysterious agency dassassins has become rebellious in his first mission, pursuing a dangerous group of human traffickers. / Un jove recluta duna agència misteriosa dassassins sha tornat rebel en la seva primera missio, perseguint un perillos grup de traficants dessers humans.

programme.title: Dark waters / Aigues fosques
programme.desc: An Ohio environmental lawyer embarks on a trial against a chemical company that is contaminating the drinking water of a small city.In 1998, lawyer Robert Bilott received the call from a farmer whose cattle had begun to die in strange circumstances. Two years later, man made one of the most transcendental decisions of his life: to sue the almighty company Dupont, of which he suspected that he was the cause of these deaths. Bilott ended up uncovering a contamination case that covered several decades and became a reference for a society increasingly concerned about ecology. / Un abogado ambientalista de Ohio se embarca en un juicio contra una empresa química que está contaminando el agua potable de una pequeña ciudad.En 1998, el abogado Robert Bilott recibio la llamada de un granjero cuyo ganado había empezado a morir en extrañas circunstancias. Dos años despues, el hombre tomo una de las decisiones más trascendentales de su vida: demandar a la todopoderosa empresa DuPont, de la que sospechaba que era la causante de dichas muertes. Bilott acabo destapando un caso de contaminacion que abarcaba varias decadas y se convirtio en un referente para una sociedad cada vez más preocupada por la ecología.

programme.title: World Athletics / Mundial de atletismo
programme.desc: The capital of Japan hosts one of the sports events of the year. From September 13 to 21, Tokyo houses the athletics World Cup dispute. programme.title: Squash Egypt Open / Abierto de Egipto de squash
programme.desc: One of the most prestigious events of the Squash World Tour, being considered a diamond category event by the PSA World Tour. programme.title: Sicily - Taormina / Sicilia - Taormina
programme.desc: Since the dawn of time, many legends have recounted the origin of the name of Taormina, this splendid town with the "thousand beauties" founded in 358 BC. C. On Mount Tauron by some Greeks from Naxos, one of the oldest Greek colonies on the island. From this colony, the inhabitants of Tauromenium were culturally influenced so as to build, at that time, the famous ancient theater, now a symbol of the city. But in addition to the panoramic views, breathtaking inlets and luxuriant flora, Taormina is much more: among the alleys and buildings there are architectural monuments of particular beauty, testimonies of the various dominations that, over the centuries, have created the history of the city, such as the Roman, Arab and Bourbon. Today as yesterday, however, it seems that it is the majestic Etna who stands out in front of the town who govern on the fate of men. / Fin dalla notte dei tempi, molte leggende raccontano l´origine del nome di Taormina, questa splendida cittadina dalle "mille bellezze" fondata nel 358 a. C. sul Monte Tauron da alcuni greci provenienti da Naxos, una delle più antiche colonie greche dell´isola. Da questa colonia, gli abitanti di Tauromenium furono culturalmente influenzati tanto da costruire, in quel periodo, il famoso Teatro Antico, ormai simbolo della città. Ma oltre agli scorci panoramici, alle insenature mozzafiato e alla flora rigogliosa, Taormina è molto di più: tra le viuzze e i palazzi d´epoca si scorgono monumenti architettonici di particolare bellezza, testimonianze delle varie dominazioni che, nel corso dei secoli, hanno creato la storia della città, come quella romana, araba e borbonica. Oggi come ieri, però, sembra che sia il maestoso Etna che si staglia davanti alla cittadina a governare sul destino degli uomini.

programme.title: Sports panorama / Sportpanorama
programme.sub-title: Studiogast – Roger Ronnberg, Trainer HC Fribourg-Gotteron
programme.desc: Roger Ronnberg: Friborg's master maker? The four-time Champions hockey League winner and two-time Swedish champions with Frolunda HC is supposed to drive Friborg to the first championship title in the club's history. After two years in Sweden, Ronnberg is employed abroad for the first time. The 54-year-old was committed over a year ago, since the beginning of May he has been working in Friborg. Athletics: The World Cup in Tokyo with Swiss highlightsudrey Werro Uber 800 meters and Simon Ehammer in the decathlon on the last day of the Highthletics World Cup in Tokyo. “SportsPanorama” also looks at the great exploit of the Bernese Hurden sprinter Ditaji Kambundji. Important people from their environment classify the excellent performance and anticipate the impact of their world championship title. Radsport: About the World Cup medals and a farewell ride of the street World Cup in Rwanda chasing Marlen Reusser and Stefan Kung according to Swiss World Cup medals in individual time trials, while on the Lenzerheide there is a big one: Nino Schurter enjoys his last World Cup appearance On home, the last time is 100 years old sports stadium Letzigrund celebrates its 100th birthday. Builded by FCZ members in their own hand, the “Letzi” becomes a football temple over the years, athletics fieldorado and the versatile concert stage. “SportsPanorama” looks at large figures and events that this sports comrades experienced. / Roger Ronnberg: Fribourgs Meistermacher?Der vierfache Champions-Hockey-League-Sieger und zweifache schwedische Meister mit Frolunda HC soll Fribourg zum ersten Meistertitel der Vereinsgeschichte fuhren. Nach zwolf Jahren in Schweden ist Ronnberg erstmals im Ausland angestellt. Verpflichtet wurde der 54-Jahrige vor uber einem Jahr, seit Anfang Mai arbeitet er in Fribourg.Leichtathletik: Die WM in Tokio mit Schweizer HighlightsAudrey Werro uber 800 Meter und Simon Ehammer im Zehnkampf greifen am letzten Tag der Leichathletik-WM in Tokio nach Edelmetall. «Sportpanorama» blickt zudem auf den grossartigen Exploit der Berner Hurdensprinterin Ditaji Kambundji zuruck. Wichtige Personen aus ihrem Umfeld ordnen die exzellente Leistung ein und antizipieren die Auswirkung ihres Weltmeistertitels.Radsport: Über WM-Medaillen und eine AbschiedsfahrtAn der Strassen-WM in Ruanda jagen Marlen Reusser und Stefan Kung nach Schweizer WM-Medaillen im Einzelzeitfahren, wahrend es auf der Lenzerheide zur Dernière eines ganz Grossen kommt: Nino Schurter geniesst seinen letzten Weltcup-Auftritt auf heimischem Boden.Der Letzigrund wird 100-jahrigDas Zurcher Sportstadion Letzigrund feiert seinen 100. Geburtstag. Von FCZ-Mitgliedern eigenhandig aufgebaut, wird der «Letzi» uber die Jahre zum Fussballtempel, Leichtathletik-Eldorado und zur vielseitigen Konzert-Buhne. «Sportpanorama» schaut zuruck auf grosse Figuren und Events, die diese Sportstatte erlebt hat.

programme.title: Creed III: Rockys Legacy / Creed III: Rockys Legacy
programme.desc: In "Creediii - Rocky’s Legacy" Adonis "Donnie" Creed (Michaelb.jordan, who also directs here) returns to the spotlight after years. In the meantime he has family and has a successful boxing studio in L.A., but the calmness is storted when his childhood friend Damian Anderson (Jonathanmajors) reappears after eighteen years of prison. Between the two, an intensive conflict sparked in which biographical and past management is carried into the ring. Damian, once a hope in the amateur camp, which has each struggle with unconventional, sometimes unfair methods, now challenges Adonis. He has to face his guilt - he pulled against Damien Blank at the time - but also has to stand his husband as the son of the legendary Apollo Creed. The struggle gave way to the final examination of its own history. Obwohl Michaelb.jordan his figure with emotional depth, family conflicts (among other things with his incorporated daughter) and stylized, based on anime box scenes, it becomes clear: he wants to carry the "Rocky-DNA" on-even without a New Year's Eve in front of the camera. Stallone was not there as Rocky, but remains closely connected to the franchise as a producer. / In «Creed III – Rocky’s Legacy» kehrt Adonis «Donnie» Creed (Michael B. Jordan, der hier zugleich Regie fuhrt) nach Jahren im Ruhestand zuruck ins Rampenlicht. Mittlerweile hat er Familie und fuhrt ein erfolgreiches Boxstudio in L.A., doch die Ruhe wird gestort, als sein Jugendfreund Damian Anderson (Jonathan Majors) nach achtzehn Jahren Gefangnis wieder auftaucht. Zwischen den beiden entfacht ein intensiver Konflikt, bei dem Biografisches und Vergangenheitsbewaltigung in den Ring getragen wird.Damian, einst eine Hoffnung im Amateurlager, der seine Kampfe jeweils mit unkonventionellen, teilweise unfairen Methoden ausgetragen hat, fordert nun Adonis heraus. Dieser muss sich so seiner Schuld stellen – er zog damals gegen Damien blank – muss aber auch als Sohn des legendaren Apollo Creed seinen Mann stehen. Der Kampf gerat so zur finalen Auseinandersetzung mit der eigenen Geschichte.Obwohl Michael B. Jordan seine Figur mit emotionaler Tiefe, Familienkonflikten (unter anderem mit seiner gehorlosen Tochter) und stilisierten, an Anime angelehnten Boxszenen neu ausgestaltet, wird deutlich: Er will die «Rocky-DNA» weitertragen – auch ohne Sylvester Stallone vor der Kamera. Stallone war zwar nicht als Rocky dabei, bleibt aber als Produzent eng mit dem Franchise verbunden.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong / Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: The primeval-echse Godzilla is anger and attacks a research facility from APEX; Madison, Bernie and Josh want to find out why. APEX boss Simmons wants to open the hollow earth for resources and get the help of Dr. Nathan Lind and Giant Gorilla Kong. The struggle of the titans comes, while an even biger danger brides together in the background ... / Die Urzeit-Echse Godzilla ist wutend und greift eine Forschungseinrichtung der Firma Apex an; Madison, Bernie und Josh wollen herausfinden warum. Apex-Chef Simmons will die Hohlerde fur Ressourcen erschlieSSen und holt sich dafur die Hilfe von Dr. Nathan Lind und Riesengorilla Kong. Es kommt zum Kampf der Titanen, wahrend sich im Hintergrund eine noch groSSere Gefahr zusammenbraut ...

programme.title: Joanna Lumley's dream city councils in Europe / Joanna Lumleys Traumstadte Europas
programme.desc: Joanna Lumley makes a trip three of the most beautiful city in Europe. In this episode she visits Berlin, the city, which was shared for almost thirty years and became a symbol for the Cold War. Today Berlin is a melting pot of many cultures and a playground for creativity of all kinds. It seems that it is easier to be in Berlin, in any case it is allowed. Joanna Lumley runs through the city and visits people who stand there: be it when driving a motorcycle through Berlin, when visiting a hat maker, a very special concert or nightlife - it can be small or big experience. But she also changes on the paths of the moving Berlin history. / Joanna Lumley macht eine Reise zu drei der schonsten Stadte Europas. In dieser Folge besucht sie Berlin, die Stadt, die fast dreissig Jahre lang geteilt war und zum Sinnbild fur den kalten Krieg wurde. Heute ist Berlin ein Schmelztiegel vieler Kulturen und eine Spielwiese fur Kreativitat jeglicher Art. Es scheint, dass anders zu sein in Berlin leichter ist, auf jeden Fall ist es erlaubt.Joanna Lumley fuhrt durch die Stadt und besucht Menschen, die dafur stehen: Sei es bei der Fahrt mit dem Motorrad durch Berlin, beim Besuch einer Hutmacherin, eines ganz besonderen Konzerts oder des Nachtlebens – uberall kann sie kleine oder grosse Überraschungen erleben. Aber sie wandelt auch auf den Pfaden der bewegten Berliner Geschichte.

programme.title: 3 on two / 3 auf zwei
programme.desc: “3 on two” is radio to look at. SRF two switches live to Radio SRF 3-studio and makes good music, news, weather, games, sports and fun to get up every morning-and this has been retained since 2010. / «3 auf zwei» ist Radio zum Anschauen. SRF zwei schaltet live ins Radio SRF 3-Studio und bringt jeden Morgen zum Aufstehen gute Musik, News, Wetter, Spiele, Sport und Spass auf die Bildschirme – und dies bewahrt seit 2010.

programme.title: Wochenruckblick Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi / Wochenruckblick Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi
programme.desc: In “Mini Chuchi, Dini Chuchi”, hobby cooks pretend their favorite dish. Every week there is also a new motto. Who cooks the best dish according to the motto "Lattich" and wins the round? / In «Mini Chuchi, dini Chuchi» prasentieren Hobbykochinnen und Hobbykoche ihr Lieblingsgericht. Jede Woche steht zudem unter einem neuen Motto. Wer kocht nach dem Motto «Lattich» das beste Gericht und gewinnt die Runde?

programme.title: Tagesschau 20 years ago / Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren
programme.desc: The “Tagesschau” of Swiss television has been providing the news look since 1953. Over the years, the program has been adapted again and again - to the technological developments, but above all to the necessary things of the audience. The aim is to bring the most important topics at home and abroad every evening. Which domestic debates and international conflicts prompted the reporting at the time - and which of them are still doing it today? The view of the archive offers the possibility of climbing, classifying and remembering. / Die «Tagesschau» des Schweizer Fernsehens liefert seit 1953 allabendlich den Nachrichtenuberblick. Im Laufe der Jahre wurde die Sendung immer wieder angepasst – an die technologischen Entwicklungen, vor allem aber an die Bedurfnisse des Publikums. Gleich geblieben ist der Anspruch, jeden Abend die wichtigsten Themen im In- und Ausland kurz und verstandlich aufzubereiten.Die «Tagesschau vor 20 Jahren» bietet einen Nachrichtenruckblick in die jungere Geschichte: Welche Themen bewegten heute vor exakt 20 Jahren? Welche innenpolitischen Debatten und internationalen Konflikte pragten damals die Berichterstattung – und welche davon tun es bis heute? Der Blick ins Archiv bietet die Moglichkeit zum Anknupfen, Einordnen und Erinnern.

programme.title: Srf Bi de Lut - Familiensache / SRF bi de Lut – Familiensache
programme.desc: In the funften and last episode of "SRF Bi de Lut - Family things", Chrigi Colliard is awarded for her commitment as a foster mother, Jan's biological mother answered his letter and Martin Lutz gave up his beloved car. / In der funften und letzten Folge von «SRF bi de Lut – Familiensache» wird Chrigi Colliard fur ihr Engagement als Pflegemutter ausgezeichnet, Jans leibliche Mutter hat auf seinen Brief geantwortet und Martin Lutz gibt sein geliebtes Auto ab.

programme.title: Cultural period / Kulturzeit
programme.desc: Since 1995, the “culture” has been offering current, critical and in -depth cultural reporting from Monday to Friday. The 3sat partner format from ZDF, ORF, SRF and ARD looks over transmitter and landing borders. In art and culture, the magazine is looking for answers to today's questions. Praseed by moderators from three countries and four channels. / Seit 1995 bietet die «Kulturzeit» von Montag bis Freitag aktuelle, kritische und vertiefende Kulturberichterstattung. Das 3sat-Partnerformat von ZDF, ORF, SRF und ARD blickt uber Sender- und Landergrenzen. In Kunst und Kultur sucht das Magazin Antworten auf die Fragen von heute. Prasentiert von Moderatorinnen und Moderatoren aus drei Landern und von vier Sendern.

programme.title: The village of the cats / Das Dorf der Katzen
programme.desc: Rovio, known as the village of the cats, suffers the sad fate of many little Ticino Dorfer: it loses its resident and thus its identity. The artist Yuri Catania, who moved to Rovio, has decided to contribute to the revival of the village. / Rovio, bekannt als das Dorf der Katzen, erleidet das traurige Schicksal vieler kleiner Tessiner Dorfer: Es verliert seine Einwohnenden und damit seine Identitat. Der Kunstler Yuri Catania, der nach Rovio gezogen ist, hat beschlossen, zur Wiederbelebung des Dorfes beizutragen.

programme.title: Paths to the Gluck / Wege zum Gluck
programme.desc: Max Gerat is increasingly under pressure. Only through his tactical skill succeeds in leaving everyone involved in faith, Nina is doing well. But the truth looks different: Nina's hunger strike now has its effect, her enrolled swindles. Will Max appear in the forest hute in good time and Nina finally release? Annabelle is strongly hit by Richard's negative reaction. She supervises her husband and Falkental for always leaving. Stefan and Silke finally took time for themselves again. But with a romantic picnic, you are unexpectedly thwarted you. / Max gerat immer mehr unter Druck. Nur durch sein taktisches Geschick gelingt es ihm, alle Beteiligten im Glauben zu lassen, Nina gehe es gut.
